science.countUnit: completed double-stranded molecules at the end of a cycle

presentation.groupedExtension: All daughters of the same product class extend together; double, single and exact classes are inspected in sequence through cycle six. Classes can also react concurrently in real PCR.
presentation.countTiming: Statistics are the last completed cycle, never partial ssDNA plus dsDNA totals.
presentation.afterCycle6: From cycle seven, retain the exact completed sixth-cycle scene with its 64 duplexes, positions, names and colors. Only the right-side actual counts continue.
presentation.primerContinuity: The same first-cycle primer nodes remain visible and stationary through initial positioning and denaturation. During annealing they move directly from those fixed positions onto the binding sites, before extension starts.
presentation.layout: Fixed 1440 by 640 plane with no reaction scrolling. Cycles 1 to 3 preserve their single-column positions; cycles 4 to 6 use two columns at uniform molecular scales 0.45, 0.32 and 0.20.
presentation.reducedMotion: Paused initial state and manual timeline are available.

assumptions: One finite original duplex, internal specific primers, ideal complete extension and 100 percent efficiency.
First products are asymmetric duplexes with overhangs, not equal-length long pairs.
A long or single-long category is defined by the envelope of the whole paired molecule.
Ignore late-cycle cross-reannealing, non-specific products, plateau effects and non-templated A addition.
The representative drawing does not encode the actual abundance by the number of visible objects.

objects: 84-position extension of the original illustrative motif and complement mapping
base connector and colored base glyph
original/new/primer origin color semantics (tones darkened in 2.1.0)
coordinateAdaptations: Local x origin shifted to interval start; base cell width remains 14.
Full template extended to 84 positions; internal target [15,69), primer spans 18 each.
Continuous clipping reveals primer then each residue to the actual template end.
